text:
Nikhil (Product): quick follow-up from the all-hands pricing segment  can we pin down rollover + rate-limit behavior so docs/console copy is consistent?
Sam (Finance): TL;DR: trial credits expire at end of trial (no rollover). paid accounts: auto-rollover up to 25% of monthly allotment, valid for 30 days. enterprise SOWs can override.
Nikhil (Product): automatic for paid accounts? opt-in for anyone?
Sam (Finance): automatic for standard paid. opt-in only for bespoke enterprise credit arrangements (SOW).
Maya (Eng): implementation question: if a request arrives with exhausted monthly + rollover, what's our behavior? return 429 or queue?
Iris (Support): plan is soft-throttle via burst buffer for short spikes; once burst drained we return 429 with a helpful payload. docs should show example 429 and suggested retry semantics.
Maya (Eng): sample 429 we'd return (for SDKs / console):
```json
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "detail": "Monthly credits exhausted; burst buffer applied. Next available tokens in 37s.",
  "retry_after": 37
}
```
Nikhil (Product): console message should be friendly: "You've used your monthly credits. Rolled-over credits expire in 30 days. Retry in 37s or upgrade to Dedicated for steady capacity."
Ava (CEO): customer-facing messaging should be short and consistent: "Trial credits do not roll over. Paid credits may roll over up to 25% and expire after 30 days." Please ensure marketing FAQ mirrors this.
Iris (Support): customers keep asking for per-product quotas (generation vs embeddings). roadmap?
Sam (Finance): Q3 rollout: per-product buckets with sensible defaults (embeddings/generation/rerank). current customers get defaults; custom splits possible via support for now; enterprise customers can fix via SOW.
Maya (Eng): engineering details: burst buffer implemented as a token-bucket with 2x burst multiplier and 30s decay window. will add metrics for burst utilization.
Nikhil (Product): what about internal sandboxes / demo orgs? Mirror trials or allow rollover?
Ava (CEO): internal accounts flagged by SSO group 'redwood-internal' get higher monthly allotment and 50% rollover. demo orgs remain trial-like.
quota-bot: Reminder: update /docs/credits-rollover and /console/credits-ux by 2026-04-10. Owner: @Nikhil.
Iris (Support): I'll draft a short support FAQ and canned responses for the 429 case.
Sam (Finance): operational note: if a customer consistently relies on the burst buffer, surface a recommendation to switch to Dedicated/reserved capacity.
Maya (Eng): action: PR for burst algorithm + docs snippets next week.
Nikhil (Product): I'll prepare a one-pager and a tiny diagram for the all-hands recap.
Ava (CEO): thanks everyone, this is actionable. flag any potential SLA tradeoffs immediately. :thumbsup:
